title: Named places of the search box (registry/<body>/places.yaml)
description: Dune fields and other named places the search box can find. The named search is shown only when `enabled` is true.

enabled.description: show the named search (and the naming note in the dune layer's info)

credit.description: source line of the names in map image exports while the names are shown

note_links.description: parts of the note shown as links (first occurrence of `text`)

note.description: naming note (verbatim): the dune layer's and Show names' info, About, and under the search results

line2.description: the name in a non-Latin script, with its language (BCP 47 tag, e.g. ar, zh-Hans, mn-Cyrl)

type.description: feature type, shown with the name in the results (Mars: the IAU descriptor term, e.g. Crater, Unda)

alt_names.description: other names (searchable) with a note on their script, meaning and language (popup)

includes.description: named parts of the area (popup: 'Includes'); their names are aliases

radius_km.description: approximate radius of the area; sets the zoom

dune_km2.description: mapped dune area of the place (km²); among equally good matches, larger areas come first

countries.description: Earth: the countries the area lies in (English short names)

sources.description: where the name and location come from
